1 / total assets: Reciprocal of lagged total assets. Formula: 1 / Assets_{t−1}. Raw inputs are in R_ANN; preserve unresolved source definitions and do not tune to reported coefficients.

ΔRevenue − ΔReceivables: Change in revenue less change in receivables, scaled by lagged total assets. Formula: (ΔRevenue_t − ΔReceivables_t) / Assets_{t−1}. Raw inputs are in R_ANN; preserve unresolved source definitions and do not tune to reported coefficients.

Property, plant, and equipment: Property, plant, and equipment divided by lagged total assets. Formula: PPE_t / Assets_{t−1}. Raw inputs are in R_ANN; preserve unresolved source definitions and do not tune to reported coefficients.

ΔCash from operations: Change in cash from operations divided by lagged total assets. Formula: ΔCFO_t / Assets_{t−1}. Raw inputs are in R_ANN; preserve unresolved source definitions and do not tune to reported coefficients.

ROA: Return on assets included as a control in the normal-accrual fit per endnote 6; the printed equation does not show its placement or coefficient. Formula: ROA (definition in Table 1: income before extraordinary items / lagged total assets). Raw inputs are in R_ANN; preserve unresolved source definitions and do not tune to reported coefficients.

|ABACC|: Absolute abnormal accruals, scaled by lagged total assets, computed annually by two-digit SIC over 1993–98 and averaged within four rolling three-year windows (1993–95, 1994–96, 1995–97, 1996–98). Formula: Mean across each three-year window of |(earnings #18 − cash flows adjusted for extraordinary items #308−#124 − fitted normal accruals)/assets_{t−1}|. Raw inputs are in R_ANN; preserve unresolved source definitions and do not tune to reported coefficients.
